summary: Vanillaware and Atlus's sci-fi narrative adventure and strategy hybrid about thirteen intertwined pilots.

entries.title: 13 Sentinels: Aegis Rim

emulation.notes: Use native PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility.

primary.why: The PS4 release is the higher-fidelity console route, and the post-launch PS4 update added the Switch version's extra weapons/content parity.
primary.how_to_play: Play the fully patched PS4 version on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility. Switch is excellent for portability, but not the best capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Confirm the PS4 copy is fully patched before starting the archive run.
